nodes.description: Private mapping(address=>uint256) tracking token balances of every account.
Private nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) tracking approved spending allowances.
Private uint256 holding the total token supply in circulation.
Private string storing the token name (DogeRun Token).
Private string storing the token symbol (DOGER).
Private uint8 holding the number of decimals, initialized to 18.
Private uint256 holding the initial supply 7777777777 used for the constructor mint.
Address of the caller, returned by Context._msgSender(), used as owner/beneficiary of allowances and transfers.
Deploys the token: sets name/symbol and mints _initialSupply * 10**_decimals to msg.sender.
Returns the token name stored in _name.
Returns the token symbol stored in _symbol.
Returns the decimals value stored in _decimals.
Returns the current _totalSupply.
Returns the balance of the given account from _balances.
Public entry point that moves tokens from msg.sender to recipient via _transfer.
Returns the allowance that spender has over owner's tokens.
Public entry point that sets an allowance for spender from msg.sender via _approve.
Public entry point that moves tokens on behalf of sender using the allowance mechanism and reduces the allowance.
Atomically increases the allowance granted to spender by msg.sender.
Atomically decreases the allowance granted to spender by msg.sender.
Internal core transfer logic: validates addresses/balance, updates _balances, emits Transfer, invokes hooks.
Internal mint logic: increases _totalSupply and credits account balance, emits Transfer from zero address.
Internal approval logic: writes _allowances[owner][spender] and emits Approval.
Empty virtual hook invoked before any token transfer, mint or burn.
Empty virtual hook invoked after any token transfer, mint or burn.
Context helper returning msg.sender; used indirectly by public state-changing functions.
Unchecked subtraction _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount inside _transfer.
Balance credit _balances[recipient] += amount inside _transfer.
_totalSupply += amount inside _mint, increasing supply without cap.
_balances[account] += amount inside _mint, crediting minted tokens.
Unchecked subtraction currentAllowance - amount when lowering allowance in transferFrom.
Unchecked subtraction currentAllowance - subtractedValue inside decreaseAllowance.
Addition _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue inside increaseAllowance, prone to overflow on unchecked paths.
Multiplication _initialSupply * 10**_decimals computed in the constructor for the initial mint amount.
Parameter account of balanceOf, used to index _balances.
Parameter recipient of transfer, forwarded to _transfer.
Parameter amount of transfer, forwarded to _transfer.
Parameter owner of allowance, used to index _allowances.
Parameter spender of allowance, used to index _allowances.
Parameter spender of approve, forwarded to _approve.
Parameter amount of approve, forwarded to _approve.
Parameter sender of transferFrom, owner whose tokens are moved.
Parameter recipient of transferFrom, destination of the tokens.
Parameter amount of transferFrom, both transferred and deducted from allowance.
Local cache of _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] read before the unchecked allowance reduction.
Parameter spender of increaseAllowance.
Parameter addedValue of increaseAllowance, added to the existing allowance.
Parameter spender of decreaseAllowance.
Parameter subtractedValue of decreaseAllowance, subtracted from the existing allowance.
Local cache of _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] used for the require check and unchecked subtraction.
Parameter sender of _transfer, debited by the transfer.
Parameter recipient of _transfer, credited by the transfer.
Parameter amount of _transfer, value moved between balances.
Local cache of _balances[sender] used for the require check and unchecked debit.
Parameter account of _mint, beneficiary of newly minted tokens.
Parameter amount of _mint, value added to supply and balance.
Parameter owner of _approve, allowance owner.
Parameter spender of _approve, allowance beneficiary.
Parameter amount of _approve, new allowance value.
Parameter from of the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Parameter to of the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Parameter amount of the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Parameter from of the _afterTokenTransfer hook.
Parameter to of the _afterTokenTransfer hook.
Parameter amount of the _afterTokenTransfer hook.

edges.reason: Constructor invokes _mint to create the initial token supply.
The initial supply multiplication result is consumed by the constructor as the mint amount.
_initialSupply is the left operand of the initial mint multiplication.
_decimals is the exponent in 10**_decimals used by the initial mint multiplication.
msg.sender is the account that receives the entire initial mint.
_mint increases _totalSupply by amount.
_mint increases _balances[account] by amount.
_mint writes to the _balances mapping.
_mint writes to the _totalSupply state variable.
The mint amount parameter flows into the _totalSupply addition.
The mint account parameter indexes the balance addition.
transfer delegates the transfer logic to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the transfer logic to _transfer.
_transfer performs the unchecked balance subtraction for the sender.
_transfer performs the balance addition for the recipient.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping.
_transfer calls the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
_transfer calls the overridable _afterTokenTransfer hook after mutating balances.
_mint calls the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook before updating supply/balances.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
increaseAllowance calls _approve with the incremented allowance.
decreaseAllowance calls _approve with the decremented allowance.
approve calls _approve to set the allowance.
The unchecked allowance subtraction result is passed into _approve in transferFrom.
The unchecked allowance subtraction result is passed into _approve in decreaseAllowance.
The allowance addition result is passed into _approve in increaseAllowance.
transferFrom reduces the allowance stored in _allowances via unchecked math.
increaseAllowance computes the new allowance from the _allowances mapping value.
_approve writes the new allowance into the _allowances mapping.
msg.sender is used as the debited sender in transfer.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender indexes the spender allowance entry in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner in increaseAllowance.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner in decreaseAllowance.
